summary_en: 1,000 shares (0.33% of shares outstanding) to be acquired for ¥3.405M via ToSTNeT-3 off-auction execution at reference price ¥3,405/share on 27 July 2026 at 08:45 JST. Order limited to specified execution window; results to be disclosed after market close.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Purchase of Treasury Shares via Off-Auction Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 24 July 2026, SUGA STEEL's board of directors authorized a single-block acquisition of 1,000 of its own shares (0.33% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a total of ¥3.405M. The purchase will be executed on 27 July 2026 at 08:45 JST via ToSTNeT-3 off-auction trading at the reference price of ¥3,405 per share. The order is limited to that execution window only; partial or complete non-execution is possible depending on market conditions. Results will be disclosed after the market closes on 27 July. The company states the purpose as improving capital efficiency, enabling flexible capital policy execution, and providing shareholder returns.
